topology_reasoning.device: four-port orthogonal multimode-interference crossing / symmetric junction
topology_reasoning.observation: The calibrated black region is a fourfold-symmetric plus shape: four straight narrow ports terminate in four convex, lens-like lobes that overlap at the center. The horizontal and vertical axes are equivalent; there are no separate metal or cladding features.
topology_reasoning.working_model: Represent each cardinal arm as a narrow straight port followed by two opposing linear tapers, widening to a broad lobe and narrowing toward the central junction. Boolean-union the four primitive arm assemblies. This preserves the observed connected four-port topology while keeping all geometry primitive and parametric.
topology_reasoning.coordinate_and_scale: Use the 4.7 um calibrated material bbox as the intended outer span; center the junction at the origin and place equal horizontal and vertical arms on layer (1, 0).

iterations.change_made: Initial primitive construction: four cardinal arms, each with four linear taper segments approximating the convex lobe, plus a straight port. Widths and lengths were selected from the calibrated 4.7 um bbox and visible pixel extents.
